title: GeoX-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-View Geo-Localization and Pose Estimation Capabilities of Large Multimodal Models

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating normalized entropy, Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence from a uniform distribution, and mode probability (the frequency of the most-predicted answer) to quantify LMMs' algorithmic preference or heuristic reliance on a single multiple-choice option.
